svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · Masks card · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift — the grading editor in its own resizable window (PhotoEditorWindowRequest scene in LetsLapseApp; default 1000×700 drawn here, min 720×480; the window chrome owns title and close, so there is no in-content back button or Done bar). REBUILT 2026-09-13 around the editor-controls redesign (Claude Design handoff “LetsLapse Editor slider organization”, boards 3b · 6c; spec sections 1–5, 9, 10): the seven-section always-open panel is gone; the grade is five GROUPS + Presets (App/EditorControls/EditorGroup.swift — Light: Exp · Con / High · Wh / Shad · Bl; Color: WB / Vib · Sat / Mixer; Effects: Tex · Clar / Vignette / Dehaze; Detail: Sharpen / Noise; Crop: aspect chips + Angle), each opened from a main button into ONE card of tool chips over an XY PAD (App/EditorControls/XYPad.swift) with two readouts, and closed by Revert (restores the snapshot taken when the panel opened) or Done (keeps). THIS FILE: the MASKS CARD on the redesigned rail with NO group open — the rail is tab pill, main buttons (none highlighted; the Light and Color dots lit by the staged grade), the Masks card, “Reset adjustments” and the preset offer. MasksCard (App/Overlay/MasksCard.swift) with compactRows, the Mac's default since the redesign (board 3b, rail item 4): the header “Masks · 2 applied · Manage ›” (13.5 semibold / 11.5 / 12.5 semibold accent), then ONE ROW PER GRADE in list order, 8 apart: a 44×36 MaskTile (an inverted grade draws WHITE where it selects, carries ⊘ bottom-left and a hairline; the open grade a 2 pt accent ring; a disabled grade a 55 % wash), the mask's name 13.5 semibold (inverted names carry “ · inverted” and truncate), “Radial · enabled” 11 pt, then the grade as TOOL ICONS — every tool it moves at full ink and, for each section it leaves alone, that section's first tool at 35 % (Sun: WB + Exp · Con lit, Vib · Sat and Tex · Clar dim; Quay lift: High · Wh + Vib · Sat lit, WB and Tex · Clar dim) — 16 pt, 3 apart, then a chevron. The row's parts are 8 apart rather than the board's 10 so the longest built-in caption fits beside four icons. No add tile on this layout: a second grade is added from the Masks tab (Manage ›, which selects this mask there). Click a row to expand its grade under the rows; click again or ✕ to collapse. THE EXPANDED GRADE, drawn as shipped and STALE BY DESIGN: under a divider, the mask's name 15 bold with its kind beneath, Reset while non-neutral, a 20 pt ✕; Enabled and Show mask with Remove trailing; then the OLD sectioned slider rows — White Balance (Temp, Tint), Light (Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows), Color (Saturation), Effects (Clarity, Dehaze) — on native macOS sliders (grey track, 20 pt white knob, no accent fill), the 2026-09-07 card's rows, not the redesign's groups and pads; regrouping the masked grade into the same tools / pads as the whole-picture panel is OWED (INDEX.md). The two ranges that differ on purpose stand: Exposure ±2 EV and Temp a RELATIVE ±25 mired read out in Kelvin (“+452 K”), a region cannot declare a second illuminant. The picture carries the open mask's handles (MaskShapeOverlay: 1.2 pt outline, dashed inner feather ellipse, four 11 pt cardinal handles turning with the ellipse, the rotation knob on a 26 pt stalk — clipped by the picture's edge here). Render order is the point: whole-picture grade → each enabled MaskGrade in list order → text overlays; preview and export run the same stage. TIMELINE (6c): with the Editor tab up on an interval shoot the strip leaves the rail and takes a 54 pt row under the media pane — padding 6 top / 16 sides, GradeTimelineView on its COMPACT metrics (26 pt play disc, 12 pt gap, 3 pt rail at primary 18 %, 11 pt moments with the 2 pt #C36A00 ring, 3×20 playhead in #1C1C1E drawn UNDER the moments, the elapsed bubble 8 pt above the row, 10 pt h:mm:ss end labels 2 pt under the track row) and the two 26 pt frame steps 6 apart at the right; on the light surface the discs are #E9E9EB with accent glyphs and the bubble is white with a shadow and black text. Track x=74…609. The INTERVAL badge (EditorMarqueeBadge — kind · length · frame count, 20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold) sits bottom-left of the pane at (12, 12). Staged by LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset: three owned-white moments at 10 / 52 / 86 % (6100 K / 7600 K / 5400 K with Exposure 0 / −0.20 / −0.50, Highlights −0.20 / −0.35 / −0.10, Shadows +0.10 / +0.18 / +0.30, Vibrance +0.12 / +0.38 / +0.10), the playhead at 30 % — so the keyframed fields are whiteMired, exposure, highlights, shadows and vibrance, and the values under the playhead are the eased blend of the first two moments (6715 K, Exposure −0.09, Highlights −27). The clock strings drawn (0:40:12, 2:14:00, 2 h 14 min · 58 frames) are the board's sample data; the 2026-09-13 captures ran on the bench shoot “Stack 2. 9. at 21:03” (1 h 34 min · 5660 frames, playhead 0:28:18). RAIL (3b / 6c): a FIXED 330 pt rail (railWidth, macOS) right of a hairline Divider — resizing the window grows the picture, never the controls. On the Editor page the whole rail scrolls, tab pill included: padding 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between items. Top to bottom: (1) RailTabBar as a white capsule (padding 3, equal segments 2 apart, 13 pt semibold, the selected segment LL.accent with a white label) — Editor · Text · Frames · Masks, Frames only where frames do (availableRailTabs); (2) EditorGroupBar .macCard — a white card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells spread edge to edge: 18 pt SF Symbol (photo.stack, sun.max, circle.lefthalf.filled, sparkles, triangle, crop.rotate), 9.5 pt semibold label, a 4 pt dot lit when the group holds a value or a travelling field, idle ink #6D6D72, the OPEN group on LL.accent 12 % with accent ink; a tap opens that group's panel and snapshots the grade, a tap on the open group leaves it open — closing is the panel's Revert / Done; (3) the open group's PhotoAdjustmentsPanel as a white radius-12 card padded 12 with 10 between rows: the header (title 13.5 semibold #6D6D72, the 6 pt dot when non-neutral, then Reset in accent text while non-neutral, the Revert pill #E9E9EB and the Done pill LL.accent, both 12 pt semibold, 23 tall, radius 7 — Done keeps the values and drops the snapshot, Revert restores it, both close), then the group's content; (4) MasksCard on its compact rows; (5) “Reset adjustments” 13 pt semibold accent, 4 in from the rail's content edge; (6) the inline “Save these edits as a preset?” offer whenever the state is Edited, since the window chrome owns the exit (not on the boards — flagged). Group card 62 tall at y=110; the panel card starts at y=184. STAGED by LL_MASKGRADE=first: a radial “Sun” (+452 K / +0.35 EV) open, and a linear “Quay lift” applied INVERTED (Highlights −35, Saturation +12) — in memory only, the sidecar never learns of them. The card runs under the window's fold from the Light section on (Shadows, Color › Saturation, Effects › Clarity / Dehaze, the card's footnote, and the offer below it are reached by scrolling). STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): the collapsed card (rows only); the empty one-row card (photo-viewer.keyframes.svg draws it — “Masks · ＋ Add”); a disabled grade's wash; the armed-label DRAG ↕ chip and its HUD pill (wide layouts arm a slider label for a vertical drag on the picture); the WHOLE PICTURE eyebrow the old panel carried under an open grade — the redesign has no always-open panel under the card, the open group's card sits ABOVE it. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=latest LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_MASKGRADE=first (|shapes|empty). Verified 2026-09-13 against the running Debug build (rows, icons, the expanded header and sections; the capture showed the rail's legacy scroller since the card outruns the window).
svg.text: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · Masks card · 1000×700 pt window
